petrostate.name: Forge Dominion
petrostate.title: Industry today. A cleaner tomorrow.
petrostate.description: Your industrial heartland exports energy and materials. Emissions travel beyond your borders; invest in clean power before extraction runs out.

heartland.name: Highland Hold
heartland.title: The highlands hold the headwaters.
heartland.description: Control the headwaters and nurture forests, farms and wetlands. Protect natural buffers or divert water, knowing every decision reaches your downstream neighbors.

enclave.name: Verdant Reach
enclave.title: Knowledge takes root. Cooperation grows.
enclave.description: Use scientific insight, forecasts and efficient trade to prosper with limited land. Share discoveries and build resilient infrastructure before disasters arrive.

archipelago.name: Tidehaven
archipelago.title: Every river ends at your shore.
archipelago.description: Island fisheries and geothermal power support your people. Guard the strait, preserve mangroves and prepare for storms, tsunamis and upstream pollution.
